newsitem.title: INDIA: India's Syndicate Bank launches Internet page.
newsitem.headline: India's Syndicate Bank launches Internet page.

text.p: India's state-run Syndicate Bank on Tuesday said it was launching its page on the internet.
"The home page is mainly to serve NRIs (non-resident or expatriate Indians) all over the world," it said.
The page will detail various deposit schemes for NRIs, interest rates and information on baggage rules and the like.
R.V. Gupta, deputy governor of the Reserve Bank of India formally inaugurated the page on Tuesday in the presence of N.K. Thingalaya, Syndicate Bank's chairman, it said.
